title: Choose artist-mcp's visual world
question: Choose the world that should carry the public landing page and connection dashboard.

options.label: Signal-flow ledger
options.lineage: studio patch bays, channel sheets, and touring show books
options.thesis: Live OneNote context travels through a legible signal path and exits as one human-reviewed result.
options.viewport: A wide routing field connects one project page to selected roles and a single chat result beside the real sign-in action.
options.risk: Can feel like generic audio software unless the workflow remains more prominent than the controls.

options.label: Project star atlas
options.thesis: Each OneNote project is a bright anchor and the relevant roles form a temporary constellation around it.
options.case: Strong artist identification and elegant context mapping; slightly less direct at explaining installation.
options.viewport: A project constellation occupies the first viewport while the sign-in action sits in the chart index.
options.risk: Atmosphere can outrun product clarity if labels become decorative.

options.label: Artist teletext
options.lineage: broadcast teletext magazines and numbered service pages
options.thesis: The product becomes an immediate, keyboard-legible service for projects, roles, setup, and connection state.
options.case: Best raw product clarity and strong interface grammar; weaker connection to contemporary artist practice.
options.viewport: A 40-column service page demonstrates READ, COORDINATE, and RETURN beside a three-digit setup index.
options.risk: The rigid character grid can constrain long setup copy and accessibility zoom.

options.label: Backstage lantern
options.lineage: washi light sculptures and folding bamboo structures
options.thesis: Complex project administration folds flat until the artist asks, then opens into one warm, useful volume.
options.case: Welcoming and distinctive, but fuses poorly with dense connection and installation states.
options.viewport: A luminous folded workflow opens beside the sign-in form while inactive capabilities remain thin outlines.
options.risk: Soft material language may undersell the precision and trust boundary of the product.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished SaaS landing page and settings dashboard, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Headline, product explanation, sign-in action, feature proof, and a conventional authenticated settings panel.
